records.qualifications: Ansan University offers a semester-by-semester tuition reduction scholarship to help international students improve their Korean language skills and focus on their studies. 1. Not a One-Time Scholarship — Applied Every Semester! This scholarship is not a one-time benefit. It is automatically applied each semester based on your new TOPIK or KIIP results and academic performance. 3. Why It Matters The better your Korean, the lower your tuition. You can study with less financial burden. Continuous effort leads to continuous rewards.
